idea-plugin.name: DiffDB
idea-plugin.description:
DiffDB compares the schema of two databases (MySQL / PostgreSQL), directly or over an SSH tunnel, visualizes the differences as a colour-coded table, and generates dialect-aware migration SQL to bring the target in line with the source.

Read-only & safe: the plugin only reads database metadata (information_schema / pg_catalog). It never executes DDL, DML, or any write operation against your database. Generated SQL is for preview and manual execution only.

  • Works in both Community and Ultimate editions
  • No JPA / Flyway / Liquibase project setup required
  • Compare any two JDBC databases; export migration SQL
  • SSH tunnel support for remote databases
  • Connection management with import/export via YAML
  • Passwords stored in IntelliJ PasswordSafe (never plain text)
